ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% high-intensity (white) pixels on outer lobes versus 40% low-intensity (black) pixels in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity region radiates from the notch to the fluke base in a wedge shape; outer lobes are high-intensity with high-density dark-pixel rosette clusters and irregular mottling distributed across both lateral planes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees; deep central convergence point clearly visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular boundary; right lobe features high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; left lobe features discrete, high-amplitude jagged peaks and irregular valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to extreme upward-convexity at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of dark-pixel circular clusters scattered across high-intensity lobes; primary concentration on the medial/distal right lobe and secondary clusters on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark-pixel linear streaks (rake marks); prominent diagonal marks on the left lobe and a complex network of intersecting horizontal and oblique lines on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rosette scarring across both lobes; heavy texture and high-intensity protrusions at the distal tips of both lobes indicating significant calcified colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced barnacle encrustation on the extreme outer tips, creating high-relief, high-intensity geometric borders that disrupt the smooth trailing edge contour.
